html_body:
Stock Finder — Momentum Discovery

Tuesday, October 13, 2026 — Kuwait time

0 of 13 candidates cleared

Thin day. 25+ live searches plus IBKR verification across both the small/mid-cap and large-cap lanes turned up nothing that survived all 4 pre-screen gates. No padded list — see the full cut sheet below.

⚠️ Why this run came up empty

Monday Oct 12 close: Philly Semiconductor Index -2.7%, memory/optical names sold off hard, selloff extending into Tuesday's Asia session (Korea/Taiwan chip stocks down on China-rival concerns). That's a risk-off tape for the exact kind of fresh breakout this skill hunts. The handful of large-cap movers search surfaced (Salesforce, Biogen, Fair Isaac) either failed IBKR confirmation or had a real but technically broken setup underneath. No defense/haram exclusions were needed this run — everything found failed on signal quality, not on the hard screens.

Cut This Run — The Full Work

13 raw tickers surfaced across technical, flow, earnings-reaction, sector-sweep, and large-cap search lanes. Every one is accounted for below.
CRM Salesforce · Large cap · Software FADED vs IBKR

Search reported a BofA upgrade to Buy driving a +4% move. IBKR live snapshot showed only +0.42% on thin overnight volume (3,650 sh) — no confirmation of a 4% pop. A separate search also found BofA's last rating on record was Underperform ($160 PT, May 2026), contradicting the upgrade claim outright. Per the skill's rule, IBKR and the contradicting source both win over the single unconfirmed narrative. Dropped.

BIIB Biogen · Large cap · Biotech UNCONFIRMED

Single source claimed a JPMorgan upgrade to Overweight driving +4%. A dedicated follow-up search found no second source for any Oct 2026 JPMorgan BIIB rating action. IBKR shows only a stale last-close print ($229.41, zero volume, no live change) — close to its 52-week high ($230.49) but no live data confirms a fresh move today. One-source claim + no IBKR corroboration = dropped, not passed through.

FICO Fair Isaac · Large cap · Analytics/Credit scoring DEAD-CAT BOUNCE

This one is real but bad: +10.85% to $740.00 on Oct 12, and IBKR's last-close print matches exactly ($740.00) — confirmed. But IBKR's 52-week high is $1,857.98 and the 13/26-week high is $1,410.15 — the stock is down ~60% from its highs. A one-day pop inside a severe multi-month downtrend is a bounce, not a breakout; chasing it risks catching a falling knife. Also flagged ⚠️ on halal: FICO's core product (credit-scoring/decision software) is sold directly into conventional interest-based lending underwriting — not itself a bank, but close enough to the line that it needs your own call before any entry, independent of today's drop. Dropped on setup quality.

META Meta Platforms · Large cap · Social/AI NO FRESH CATALYST

Reported +3.4% Monday while chips sold off — a real relative-strength divergence, but no company-specific "why now" found (no earnings, no upgrade, no product news dated this week). IBKR shows it actually pulled back -0.6% on thin overnight volume since that close, right near its 52-week high ($779.82, ~5.3% below). Not fresh enough, not falling enough to be a pullback entry either. Dropped — this is also a name already all over mainstream coverage.

ZBH Zimmer Biomet · Large cap · Medtech NO SPECIFIC SIGNAL

+3.4% Oct 12 in a generic S&P mover list, no company-specific catalyst found — just a passenger on the healthcare-rotation theme. Gate 1 needs a concrete signal, not "it went up with its sector." Dropped.

CYCU Cycurion · Micro cap · Cybersecurity/IT services STALE

The ~500% spike on its $54.6M state HHS contract was July 30, 2026 — 10+ weeks old, well outside the 5-trading-day freshness window. Also a sub-$20M market cap name with an active Nasdaq delisting appeal — not sizeable or stable enough regardless. Note for the record: this contract is a civilian state health-services award via a consulting firm, not a defense/DoD award, so it wasn't cut on the exclusion rule — it's cut purely for staleness and quality.

SHLS Shoals Technologies · Small cap · Solar STALE

Guggenheim's target raise to $12 was tied to Q2 (July) results. Current price reads are inconsistent across sources ($7.01–$9.62) with no Oct 2026 data point. Too stale, and the dispersion itself is a red flag that the available data isn't reliable right now. Dropped.

FSLY Fastly · Small cap · Edge/CDN STALE

The +21% move search surfaced was tied to August Q2 earnings, not anything this week. Oct 9's "top gainer +15.86%" headline had no catalyst attached to verify. Dropped for staleness.

LVS / MGM / WYNN Casinos · Large cap HARAM — EXCLUDED

Surfaced on an oversold-RSI screen (weekly RSI 25-26, i.e. falling, not a momentum long anyway). Core business is gaming/casino operations — fails the halal screen outright regardless of price action. Dropped on the hard exclusion, not the technical.

TMUS T-Mobile · Large cap · Telecom WRONG DIRECTION

Biggest single-day loser found all run: -13.27% on Oct 9. This is a momentum-discovery skill, not a bottom-fishing one. Dropped.

NuScale / Oklo Small/mid cap · Nuclear SMR NO LIVE SIGNAL

Both reported down on the year as of the most recent dated coverage found (NuScale -27%, Oklo -11%) — thematic interest in nuclear/SMR exists but no fresh breakout or flow signal in either name this week. Dropped.

Palantir / CrowdStrike / Palo Alto / Arista / Visa / AbbVie / Dell / Moderna Large cap NO FRESH CATALYST / OVER-COVERED

A mechanical "within 2% of 52-week high" screen (Oct 10), not a fresh breakout signal — several of these have been grinding near highs for weeks and are already all over mainstream coverage, which this skill explicitly screens out. No individual name had a dated, specific "why now." Dropped as a batch.

⭐ Today's best setup

No standout setup today. Nothing found today earned the label — the closest thing to a real mover (FICO) is a bounce inside a 60%-off-highs downtrend, not a quality long. The tape itself is risk-off for growth/momentum names right now (semiconductor-led selloff spreading from US into Asia overnight). Best move is patience, not forcing a name into the shortlist to hit a count.

Scan coverage: 25 web searches across technical breakouts, options/insider/institutional flow, earnings-reaction, sector-agnostic sweep, and the mandatory large-cap lane, plus IBKR price-snapshot verification on every named mover and IBKR topic search on semiconductor/solar/biotech themes. Cap-size balance note: both small/mid-cap and large-cap lanes were searched; the large-cap lane surfaced more concrete (if ultimately flawed) candidates than small/mid-cap this run — not a lane imbalance, just where the live signal happened to be today.

Research output, not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results. This skill only finds — run analyze [TICKER] for a full deep dive before entering anything. Generated Oct 13, 2026, Kuwait time.
